Task: Confirm domain, business entity, and target pages
Success_Measurement: Prerequisites complete; no campaign until facts are verified.

Task: Connect GSC and baseline backlink exports
Deliverable: Dated backlink/referring domain exports and methodology notes
Success_Measurement: Baseline saved; distinguish observed links from estimates.

Task: Manual review of competitor link intersections
Resources: Backlink tool or manual research; analyst time
Deliverable: Qualified prospect list with source evidence
Success_Measurement: Prospects have working page, relevance, contact method and clear value.

Resources: Writer, technical reviewer, verified catalog or original data
Deliverable: Published/approved guide or tool; source log
Success_Measurement: Asset accurate, useful, accessible and available at stable URL.

Task: Create outreach tracker, rules and personalization workflow
Success_Measurement: No bulk scraping; every prospect manually reviewed.

Task: Pitch a small first cohort of relevant editors/resource owners
Resources: Approved contacts, personalized pitch, live asset
Deliverable: Sent outreach log; no purchased placements
Success_Measurement: Responses and editorial consideration recorded; no link quota.

Task: Offer expert commentary or useful contributions
Resources: Subject expert, reviewer, availability for quotes
Deliverable: Submitted expert answers or article pitches
Success_Measurement: Contribution is original, accurate and follows publication policy.

Task: Promote useful content in relevant communities
Deliverable: Useful post or answer with transparent affiliation
Success_Measurement: Community accepts contribution; referral quality and feedback reviewed.

Resources: Manual page checks; link checker; suitable equivalent asset
Deliverable: Verified broken resource and relevant proposed replacement
Success_Measurement: Do not claim breakage without retest; replacement must satisfy same need.

Resources: Original thread; follow-up schedule; editor time
Deliverable: One concise follow-up or no further contact
Success_Measurement: Respect no response/opt-out; stop after reasonable follow-up.

Task: Monitor earned/lost links and brand mentions
Objective: Track outcomes and fix broken destinations
Resources: GSC, GA4, backlink provider, alert/search workflow
Deliverable: Dated log of live links/mentions and referrals
Success_Measurement: Verify link manually; tag attributes and target page.
Report actual observed outcomes; no guaranteed link/rank target.
